<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the base peak is at m/z 194.0862. Assuming a protonated ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is 194.0862 − 1.007276 = 193.07895 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 ≈ 33 % of M) indicates a single chlorine atom, and the M+1 intensity (~13 %) matches ~12 carbons. Solving 12 C + 1.007825 H + 34.968853 Cl = 193.07895 gives the formula C₁₂H₁₄Cl (no oxygen). This fits the mass within a few ppm and the observed isotope distribution.  

The required format is CxHyOzX, so we include O₀ for completeness.>  
<final_answer>C12H14O0Cl</final_answer>
